import json,collections
r=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]; a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
a[41]['slots']['1']='ь'
a[64]['slots']['1']='ь'
a[64]['confidence']['1']='low'
a[64]['pre1918']='no'
open('answers.jsonl','w').writelines(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n' for x in a)
assert len(a)==len(r)
for inp,out in zip(r,a):
 assert inp['item_id']==out['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,inp['slots']+1)}
 assert set(out['slots'])==expected==set(out['confidence'])
 assert all(x in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for x in out['slots'].values())
 assert all(x in ['high','low'] for x in out['confidence'].values())
 assert out['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
print('Validated count, order, slot coverage:',len(a))
print('Slot counts:',dict(collections.Counter(v for x in a for v in x['slots'].values())))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(x['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for x in a))
